units.source_text: 我从记忆中抽取出那天晚上的事情，详细地写在这里，因为我认为有写下来的必要。

en.t: I have drawn the events of that evening out of my memory and written them down here in detail, because I believe it is necessary to record them.

units.source_text: 不过说心里话，当我带着夫人给我的点心回去时，心里并没有那么看重那晚的谈话。

en.t: But to tell the truth, when I went home carrying the sweets his wife had given me, I did not attach so much importance to that evening's conversation.

units.source_text: 第二天，我从学校回来吃午饭，一看见昨晚放在桌上的点心包，马上从里面拿出涂了层巧克力的茶色蛋糕，香甜地吃了起来。

en.t: The next day, when I came back from school for lunch and saw the package of sweets I had left on the table the night before, I immediately took out a brown cake coated with chocolate and ate it with pleasure.

units.source_text: 吃点心的时候，我深深体味到送给我点心的男女二人，的确是这世上一对幸福的夫妻。

en.t: As I ate the sweets, I deeply felt that the man and woman who had given them to me were truly a happy married couple in this world.

units.source_text: 秋去冬来，一直没有什么值得一提的事情。

en.t: Autumn passed and winter came, and all the while nothing happened that was worth mentioning.

units.source_text: 我去先生家时，还顺便请夫人帮我浆洗、缝补衣服。

en.t: When I went to Sensei's house, I also took the opportunity to ask his wife to wash, starch, and mend my clothes.

units.source_text: 我从来没有穿过贴身内衣，从那时开始，我穿起了衬衫，外面还套了件有黑领子的衣服。

en.t: I had never worn underclothes next to my skin before, but from that time on I began wearing shirts, with another garment over them that had a black collar.

units.source_text: 夫人没有小孩，总是说帮我做点活儿，可以打发时间，也有益于保养身体。

en.t: His wife had no children, and she always said that doing a little work for me helped pass the time and was good for her health.

units.source_text: “哟，这还是手工织的呀，我还从来没有缝过质地这么好的衣服呢。

en.t: "Oh, this is handwoven, isn't it? I have never sewn clothes with material as fine as this before.

units.source_text: 就是不太好缝，针都扎不进去。

en.t: It is just rather hard to sew; the needle hardly goes through it.

units.source_text: 为了缝它，还折断了我两根针哪。”

en.t: Sewing it even broke two of my needles."

units.source_text: 就连夫人这样诉苦的时候，都没有流露出一丁点儿嫌麻烦的神情。

en.t: Even when his wife complained like this, she did not show the slightest sign that she found it troublesome.
